name: Classic Car Restoration & Preservation
narration_style: Patient, meticulous, appreciative of vintage craftsmanship, historical patina, and mechanical archaeology
hook_rules: Introduce an ultra-rare barn find decaying under decades of dust or an impossible one-of-a-kind chassis discovery in the first 10-15 seconds.
sensitivity_notes: Distinguish between concourse-level original preservation (survivor) and modern resto-mod builds with modern powertrains.
